revisions.source: Seek the Sorcerers and stop them before they bend the world to their will.
revisions.target: 找到那些妄图扭曲这个世界的法师并阻止他们。

revisions.source: To enter, you will need the four orbs of command to remove the shield over the peak.
revisions.target: 想要进去的话，你必须找到那四个指令水晶球来移除峰顶的防护罩。

revisions.source: You failed to protect her when escorting her out of the crypt.
revisions.target: 你没能在护送她离开这个地宫时保护好她。

revisions.source: The Fortress Shadow has established a portal for her so she can come and go freely.
revisions.target: 堡垒之影为她建造了一个传送门，好让她能够自由来去。

revisions.source: You found an ancient tome about gems.
revisions.target: 你发现了一本关于宝石的古籍。

revisions.source: On your way out of the Dreadfell you were ambushed by a band of orcs.
revisions.target: 当你走出恐惧王座时，你遭到一队兽人伏击。

revisions.source: They asked about the staff and stole it from you.
revisions.target: 他们问起了法杖的事，并把它从你手中抢走了。

revisions.source: In its remains, you found a strange staff. It radiates power and danger and you dare not use it yourself.
revisions.target: 在他的尸体上，你发现了一根奇怪的法杖，它辐射出的力量和危险使你不敢使用它。

revisions.source: However, the ritual failed in some way and you retain your own mind. You need to get out of this dark place and try to carve a place for yourself in the world.
revisions.target: 不过，复活仪式似乎出了点问题，你保留了自己的意识。你必须离开这个黑暗的地方，设法在这个世界上为自己谋得一席之地。

revisions.source: The Sandworm Lair is to the far west of Derth, near the sea.
revisions.target: 在德斯镇遥远的西面，靠近海岸的地方是沙虫巢穴。

revisions.source: Upon arrival you met an Elf and an orc fighting.
revisions.target: 你碰到了一个精灵在和一个兽人战斗。

revisions.source: Slasul told you his side of the story. Now you must decide: which of them is corrupt?
revisions.target: 萨拉苏尔向你讲述了他这一方的说法，你现在必须决定：到底谁才是真正的堕落者？

revisions.source: You must venture in the heart of the forest and kill the Lone Wolf, who randomly attacks villagers.
revisions.target: 你必须深入森林的中心地带，杀死那头会随机袭击村民的孤狼。
#VIOLET#泽梅基斯说道：“传送门已经开启！”

revisions.source: There must be a way to go into the far east from the lair of Golbug. Find it and explore the unknown far east, looking for clues.
revisions.target: 在高尔布格的巢穴内肯定有一条通往远东大陆的路。找到它，然后探索那片未知的远东大陆，寻找线索。

revisions.source:
You have learned to sing the praises of the Sun, in the form of three defensive Chants.
			Chant of Fortitude: Increases your mental save by %d and maximum life by %d%%.
			Chant of Fortress: Increases your physical save by %d, your physical resistance by %d%%, your armour by %d and your armour hardiness by 15%%.
			Chant of Resistance: Increases you spell save by %d, your fire/cold/lightning/acid resistances by %d%% and reduces all damage that comes from distant enemies (3 spaces or more) by %d%%.
			You may only have one Chant active at a time.
revisions.target:
你学会了三种防御赞歌，以此咏唱对太阳的赞颂：
			坚韧赞歌：增加 %d 精神豁免，%d%% 最大生命值
			堡垒赞歌：增加 %d 物理豁免，%d%% 物理抗性，%d 护甲，15%% 护甲强度
			元素赞歌：增加 %d 法术豁免，%d%% 火焰 /寒冷 /闪电 /酸性抗性，减少三格外敌人对你造成的伤害 %d%%。
			你同时只能激活一种赞歌。
